title: Wild Life Series
description: Wild Life Series is a fan series inspired by the Minecraft YouTube series Wild Life, created by Grian and featuring creators such as Scar, Bdubs, and many others.
body: Wild Life Series is a fan-made series inspired by the Minecraft YouTube series Wild Life, created by Grian and featuring creators such as Scar, Bdubs, and many others. It captures the same chaotic survival gameplay, shifting alliances, and unpredictable challenges that made the original series so popular, while offering its own unique adventures and memorable moments.
